questions.prompt: You reference `$user` without assigning a value. What is its value and how does `"hi $user"` render?
Why is writing `$null -eq $x` (null on the left) recommended over `$x -eq $null`?

options.a: If $x is an array, $x -eq $null filters elements instead of performing a scalar compare
It coerces the string "42" to an Int32 value 42
options.b: It throws a type mismatch error
options.c: It converts 42 to a FileInfo object
